name: short-answer-graphs
does: Two pages. Short answer: one prompt at a time; the student writes an answer, then shows the model answer and ticks the key points it covers (self-check: nothing grades the text); the draft and the ticks are kept in the progress. Graphs: one card per figure of the professor's, with its questions' counts (unseen, right, wrong) and the reading questions the student skips; Drill this figure asks every question on that figure in turn, a wrong pick names the reading question skipped (the option's miss tag), each answer shows how to read the figure, and the end of the pass lists what was skipped. Reads SHORT_ANSWERS, GRAPHS, GRAPH_MISS and GRAPH_EXAMS from a data file listed in course.js `files`, and the questions whose img is a figure's key; each page appears only when its data is there.
